t: Hamsuppaq im hitpallel vedin tepillat nedaba
s: Hamsuppaq im hitpallel vedin tepillat nedaba ubo h' seipim: im hu mesuppaq im hitpallel y"ch im lav — tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel, umatneh veomer: im lo hitpallalti — tehe lechobati, veim hitpallalti — tehe lenidbati. Veap al pi shekkol sapeq middibre soperim lehaqel — hitzriku lachazor ulehitpallel, mippene shehalvay sheyyitpallel adam kol hayyom betorat nedaba. Ella sheim bari lo shehitpallel kebar vechozer umitpallel betorat nedaba — tzarik lechaddesh ezeh dabar bitpillato kede lehodia shehu nedaba, velo yehe kemaqrib b' temidin veober mishshum "bal tosip", shettepillat choba hi bimqom olat hattamid utepillat nedaba hi bimqom olat nedaba. Abal im mesuppaq im hitpallel im lav — en tzarik lechaddesh shum dabar bitpillato hab', shekkeshechozer umitpallel al hassapeq — en leka chiddush gadol mizzeh. Veal yede chiddush chozer umitpallel bindaba kol happeamim sheyyirtzeh, chutz mittepillat musap sheen mitpalelin otah bindaba apillu musap rosh chodesh, kevan sheomer "umusapim kehilkatam" vehammusapim enan qerebin ella mishshel tzibbur veen hayyachid yakol lehitnaddeb otam. Ubeshabbat veyom tob enan mitpalelin nedaba kelal, lepi sheen nedarim unedabot qerebin bahem:

Im hitchil lehitpallel leshem choba, shehaya sober shello hitpallel adayin venizkar betok hattepilla shekkebar hitpallel — tzarik lipsoq apillu beemtza beraka. Vaapillu yakol lechaddesh bah dabar — eno yakol legomrah leshem nedaba, kevan shekkebar hitchil bah leshem choba, vei epshar lehabi qorban shechetzyo choba vechetzyo nedaba:
Chiddush zeh sheamarnu hu, sheyyechaddesh ezeh dabar bekol beraka min haemtzait meen habberaka. Veim chiddesh apillu bibraka achat — dayyo, kede lehodia shehu nedaba velo choba:

En tzibbur mitpalelim tepillat nedaba, lepi sheen tzibbur mebiin qorban nedaba ella leqetz hammizbeach keshehammizbeach batel vezehu dabar sheeno matzuy, laken en lehitpallel tepillat y"ch keneged zeh. Abal yachid yakol lehitpallel tepillat nedaba apillu betzibbur:

Harotzeh lehitpallel tepillat nedaba — tzarik sheyyehe makkir et atzmo zariz vezahir veomed bedato sheyyukal lekavven bitpillato merosh vead sop, abal im eno yakol lekavven yapeh — anu qorin bo "lamma li rob zibchekem", vehalvay sheyyukal lekavven beg' tepillot haqqebuim leyom:
